lines.trans: Is contact made? What did he say?
He named the place where the money lies.
And where are these millions?
In the Golden Key kindergarten.
It seems to me, somehow everything is very simple.
And could he have lied?
He lied, of course!
So what is good about that then?
It was a test.
You think he is testing us?
We will check that kindergarten all the same.

meanings.note: мне кажется = I think, it seems to me

Кажется as a parenthetical word. Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to seem', paired with 'показаться'.

examples.trans: I think I've seen you somewhere.

meanings.note: Indefinite adverb. Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

meanings.note: Diminutive of ключ. Derived noun with agent/object suffix '-ник'/'-щик'/'-чик'. Common masculine noun meaning 'little key' in everyday Russian.

meanings.note: Чн is pronounced шн. Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.
